source.title: The kinetochore protein Cenp-F is a potential novel target for zoledronic acid in breast cancer cells

question.text: Which intermediate/doses reverse zoledronic-acid CENP-F loss, and how do cancer cytotoxicity and normal-cell segregation outcomes compare?
question.assessment: Directly answers intermediate identities/doses and reported normal-cell comparisons; quantitative normal-cell/cytotoxicity comparisons remain unavailable because relevant results were not shown and no complete fidelity-rescue experiment was performed.

model.normal_comparator: Nonmalignant MCF-10A cell line; not primary normal tissue, a donor panel or an MVA model.
model.culture_difference: Cancer lines RPMI-1640+10% fetal calf serum; MCF-10A different DMEM/HAM-F12 medium, horse serum, insulin, EGF and hydrocortisol. Treatment uptake and growth-rate causation were not measured.

identities.name: Zoledronic acid, source hydrated disodium salt
identities.role: Experimental perturbation of CENP-F localization and chromosome alignment
identities.identity_limit: Do not equate every formulation or clinical exposure to this cultured-cell salt regimen.

identities.name: trans,trans-farnesol
identities.role: Direct partial rescue of zoledronic-acid-induced CENP-F delocalization
identities.identity_limit: Source specifies the E,E isomer. Do not silently assign its result to unspecified farnesol mixtures, FPP or generic isoprenoids.

identities.name: Source-labelled trans-geranylgeraniol
identities.role: Same-dose nonsignificant CENP-F rescue comparison; higher-dose reversal reported without displayed data
identities.identity_limit: The printed trans label does not enumerate every double-bond configuration. No verified all-trans assignment or transfer to GGPP/GGOH mixtures.

identities.name: Clodronate, source disodium tetrahydrate
identities.role: Non-nitrogen bisphosphonate negative control, result not shown
identities.identity_limit: An experimental comparator null in one localization assay; not a general efficacy or safety assessment.

exposures.schedule: 1, 4, 6, 8 or 24 h exposures; Figures 3/5 captions say these are followed by incubation in medium up to 48 h, or describe 48 h continuous exposure. The exact cancer-cell pulse-to-assay mapping is not specified; do not infer 48 h total or an immediate 4–8 h time-to-effect. Figure 2 explicitly uses 10 µM for 24 h followed by 24 h drug-free. Separately, the MCF-10A Results explicitly state incubation to a total of 48 h. Main prose sometimes abbreviates the cancer schedule as 24 h treatment.
8 or24 h then drug-free to48 h, or48 h continuous

exposures.agent: Farnesol or geranylgeraniol plus zoledronic acid
exposures.schedule: Concurrent48 h; not delayed repair after established injury
exposures.endpoint: Percentage of selected pro/pro/meta-phase cells with punctate CENP-F kinetochore localization

exposures.schedule: In same rescue-results context; no separate timing/raw protocol for high-dose observation

FOH_positive.untreated: Approximately90% in graph; approximate visual context only, not raw-data reconstruction
FOH_positive.interpretation: Direct compound-specific partial restoration of protein localization in a drug-perturbed cancer line. Both combinations numerically below untreated; a rescue-versus-untreated P is not reported.
FOH_positive.FOH_alone: No significant localization effect versus control reported at50/100 µM

GGOH_mixed.50_100uM_with_ZA: Explicit ns native brackets versus ZA alone; increases in plotted means do not establish a significant effect.
GGOH_mixed.150uM_with_ZA: Authors report reversal, data not shown; no effect size/variance/exactP supplied.
GGOH_mixed.GGOH_alone: No significant localization effect versus control reported at50/100 µM
GGOH_mixed.prohibited_inference: No class-wide or all-dose GGOH null.

ZA_localization.endpoint: Fraction of scored mitotic cells showing CENP-F puncta; not total protein amount or fraction of individual kinetochores.
ZA_localization.three_cancer_lines: Localization reduced with10/25 µM exposures; Fig3 marked within-dose contrasts vary by line and time.

lower_dose_48h_MDA436.4uM: No significant effect marked/reported; exact text Table1 says below4µM but tested nonzero low dose was4µM.

ZA_mitosis.all_mitotic_cells: Significant early-phase fraction increases limited to MDA43625µM48h, MDA23110µM24h, MCF710µM24h; other conditions not universally positive.
ZA_mitosis.CENPF_negative_subset: More early-phase cells lacking CENP-F localization after ZA; endpoint partly conditions on the localization response.
ZA_mitosis.limit: Fixed-cell phase fractions, not direct single-cell transit times or completed division.

ZA_alignment.definition: Misaligned chromosomes outside prometaphase/metaphase plates among scored mitotic cells without kinetochore CENP-F; caption calls these lagging chromosomes.
ZA_alignment.tripolar: Representative morphology shown, but increase nonsignificant at every tested dose. Staining is DAPI/CENP-F, not a direct tubulin assay.
not_measured: FOH/GGOH correction of alignment or spindle defects

MCF10A_nulls.localization_mitosis: No change reported under25µM schedules, data not shown.
MCF10A_nulls.alignment_spindle: No effect reported in repeated alignment experiment, data not shown; numerical group values/P absent.
MCF10A_nulls.limits: One nonmalignant cell line in different medium; no matched viability/functional-safety panel. No normal-cell FOH/GGOH rescue study.

outcomes.cytotoxicity: Preliminary data-not-shown: no apoptosis effect in MDA436 at25µM72h or MCF7 at25µM48h. No assay description/numerical viability data supplied and no quantitative MDA231/MCF10A death comparison. The title/discussion anticancer mechanism is not a demonstrated cancer-killing/tumor-regression endpoint here.
outcomes.clodronate: 500µM48h did not alter CENP-F localization in MDA436; data not shown.

causality_and_BUB1B.bridge: BubR1 occurs in introduction/discussion and references about kinetochore assembly/SAC after CENP-F silencing. Those genetic studies are not drug measurements in this paper.
causality_and_BUB1B.mechanistic_value: FOH rescue plus clodronate comparator support mevalonate/prenylation involvement; do not isolate CENP-F as the sole causal target. Source itself discusses CENP-E/lamin B/other prenylated targets.

replication_and_statistics.localization_scoring: Methods:40 pro/pro/meta-phase cells scored as punctate CENP-F at kinetochore or not. Individual experiment values/cell allocation not provided.
replication_and_statistics.alignment_scoring: 100 mitotic cells per drug concentration stated; caption3 experiments. Treat experiment as inferential unit, not300 independent biological replicates.
replication_and_statistics.statistics: Two-way ANOVA+Bonferroni for dose/time series; one-way ANOVA+Dunnett for a single exposure time. Fig6 comparison brackets versus ZA-alone.

exposure_and_availability_limits.source_exposure_context: Authors note10–25µM sustained cultures exceed cited human plasma1–2µM after an infusion; even the6µM48h localization finding is not evidence of clinical exposure equivalence. This is source historical context, not current dosing advice.
exposure_and_availability_limits.vehicle: ZA PBS stock and clodronate water stock explicit; final carrier fractions/matched solvent-only control and FOH/GGOH solvents/purity/catalog numbers not specified.

competitive_assessment: Retain trans,trans-farnesol as valuable direct protein-localization rescue evidence and source-labelled trans-geranylgeraniol as dose-dependent evidence with an unshown high-dose positive. Neither demonstrates BUBR1 restoration, chromosome-fidelity rescue or useful normal-tissue function. ZA is a mechanistic cancer-cell perturbation, not a restoration lead here. These limits do not prove inferiority, safety or clinical harm; provisional niacin/apitegromab also remain unproven for MVA.
